verses.1: And they cried out for help, and their prayers were heard. A great multitude of people, both men and women and children, fell down before the house of God. The people wept greatly.
verses.2: And Shechemiah son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Eleazar, said to Ezer: “We have been raised up by our God. We will now set aside the foreign women from among the nations of the earth. Now, there will be a place for Israel here.”
verses.3: And now, let us make a covenant with our God. Let all women and those who are born from them be born in accordance with the will of Adonai. Let them be born under our God’s commandment and law.
verses.4: Let it happen as it is meant to happen. We will be with you, strong and capable of doing it.
verses.5: And Ezerah stood up and commanded the priests, the Levites, and all Israel to do as he said. And they obeyed.
verses.6: And Ezerah stood before the house of God. He went into the room where Jonathan, son of Eliashib, was. There, he ate no bread and drank no water, because he was very sad over the situation in the land.
verses.7: And they spread the news throughout Judea and Jerusalem, so that all the people in the land would come to Jerusalem.
verses.8: And anyone who does not come within three days, as advised by the elders and wise men, will have all his property confiscated. He will be separated from the rest of the people.
verses.9: All the people of Judah and Benjamin gathered in Jerusalem for those three days. It was the ninth day of the month of Teşriyyah, in the month of Adar. All the people sat down in the courtyards of the Temple, excitedly discussing this matter and its implications.
verses.10: And Ezer the priest stood up and said to them, “You are all men. So let the women and foreigners sit down to hear the judgment of Israel.”
verses.11: And now, give worship to Yahweh, the God of your ancestors. Do what He desires, and be separate from the people of this land and from those who are unclean women.
verses.12: And all the people answered, “Let us do as you say.”
verses.13: But the people are numerous, and time is scarce. There’s no strength to cope with such a situation. The work cannot be done by one person or even two people. After all, we’re too lazy to do this kind of work.
verses.14: Let our women stand before the entire congregation. All those who live in our cities, including foreign women, will come at this time. With them will be the elders of the city and its judges, so that they can restore order to our land from what has been done to it.
verses.15: But Jonathan, son of Asahel, and Jehoshua, son of Tikva, stood there. They helped me out of this situation.
verses.16: And so did the children of the valley. They separated Ezer, the priest, from the men who were leaders among the fathers. All of them went away in one day, on the fifteenth day of the month, during the festival of Darius.
verses.17: And all those men who were keeping women and foreign women back until the first day of the month.
verses.18: And he found among the priests those who had brought back foreign women from among the descendants of Jesus, son of Joseph. Among them were also Maasaya, Eliezer, and Yairiv.
verses.19: And they stretched out their hands to bring forth their wives, and to atone for their sins.
verses.20: And from the children of Immer Hanani and Zevadya.
verses.21: And from the children of Horem, there are Maseya, Eliyah, Shmaiyah, Yihiel, and Uziya.
verses.22: And from the children of Pashhur, my beloved ones, may they hear these words: Yishmeel, Natanel, Yozabad, and El’ashah.
verses.23: And from the nations, Yozabad, Shemei, and Kelaia will be freed. They are the ones who will open up the gates of Judah and Elyazar.
verses.24: And from the pastures, Eliyah; and from the fields, Shalom, Tzelam, and Uri.
verses.25: And from Israel, from the sons of Pharaohsh Ramia, Yizya, Malchiyah, Yamin, Elazar, Malchiyah, and Benyah.
verses.26: And from the sons of Elam, there were Matanyah, Zekriyah, Yihiel, Avdiy, Yirimot, and Eliyah.
verses.27: And from the descendants of Zathua, there were Eloyani, Elishiv, Matanya, Viremoeth, Zavad, and Azizah.
verses.28: And from the sons of Jehoshuanan, Hananiah Zabai Atlay.
verses.29: And from the children of my sons, there will be kings and rulers. They will return and ask questions.
verses.30: And from the children of Pachath Moab, from Adna, and from all the other children who were born as a result of their actions. They were born in Tzalel and in Nuy.
verses.31: And the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Shishya, Malkiya, Shemaiah, and Shemion.
verses.33: From the children of Chashum, I gave them these gifts: Zavad Eliphelt Yeramy, Menashe Shimei.
verses.34: Children of my son, Amram and Uahel.
verses.36: And they went away from there.
verses.37: May he make me what he wants me to be.
verses.38: And my children and your children, listen carefully.
verses.39: And Shelemya, and Nathan, and Adaya.
verses.43: The sons of Nebo Yael: Matityah Zabad, Zevina, Yadai, and Yoel Benaya.
verses.44: All of these people had foreign women as wives. Among them were women who gave birth to children.
